motion_contract: Levels identify the reviewed configuration families. Preserve actual per-target motion types and geometry; do not derive them from level names.
speed_contract: Each condition declares an explicit speed override. Raw source motion dictionaries retain their original alpha_mps. Zero is not a stationary condition: upstream treats alpha_mps=0 as its default speed.
phase_contract: Advance actual moving-world physics for 40 control steps before the first policy observation. This is neither seed 40 nor a phase-counter jump.
